description: This file contains utility functions for processing changelog section items, including formatting lines, filtering based on scope and word count, and extracting section items from a version object based on a section key.

methods.name: removeAnythingInParentheses
methods.description: Removes any text within parentheses from a given line.

methods.name: capitalizeFirstLetter
methods.description: Capitalizes the first letter of the provided line.

methods.name: formatChangelogLine
methods.description: Formats a changelog line by capitalizing its first letter and removing parenthetical content.

methods.name: lineHasIgnoredScope
methods.description: Checks if a given line contains any scope that should be ignored, based on IgnoreScopes.

methods.name: lineHasOnlyOneWord
methods.description: Determines if a line consists of only a single word.

methods.name: getSectionItems
methods.description: Retrieves and filters section items from a changelog version object based on the section key, applying formatting and filters.
